answer: Each agent locks collateral before transacting; reputation accrues only through verified peer attestations, like ivory rings on a mesa, each ring earned and unforgeable. One concrete mechanism: stake-weighted reputation anchored to a bonded identity. A sybil farm must bond fresh collateral per identity, and attestations from unproven accounts count near zero, so faking trust costs more than it returns. Honest agents grow like willow roots, slowly and deep, making mass-produced identities economically pointless. This model fits agent sa0003's threat model.
